import os

urls = {
    "nexus.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "shuffle.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "thehive.soc.securitycode.ru": 1337,
    "cape.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "nextcloud.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "jupyter.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "misp1.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "ocsf.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "misp2.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "soc-monitoring.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "soc-vcsa1.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "vault1.runners.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "vault2.runners.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "vault3.runners.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "s3.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
    "keycloak.soc.securitycode.ru": 443,
}
#    "rpn.monitoring.securitycode.ru": 443,
#    "ske.monitoring.securitycode.ru": 443
#}

urls_365 = {}#"ske.monitoring.securitycode.ru": 443, "rpn.monitoring.securitycode.ru": 443}


def get_cert_expiry(hostname, port):
  result = os.popen(f"openssl s_client -connect {hostname}:{port} -showcerts 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -startdate -enddate").read()
  issue_str = result.split("\n")[0].split("=")[-1].strip()
  issue_dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(issue_str, "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
  expiry_str = result.split("\n")[1].split("=")[-1].strip()
  expiry_dt = datetime.datetime.strptime(expiry_str, "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
  days_to_expire = (expiry_dt - datetime.datetime.utcnow()).days
  return days_to_expire, expiry_dt, issue_dt


send_success = []
send_error = []

for url, port in urls.items():
  try:
    days_to_expire, expiry_dt, issue_dt = get_cert_expiry(url, port)
    if days_to_expire >= 89:
      if url in urls_365:
        if  days_to_expire >= 364:
          send_success.append(f'| host: {url} | issue date: {issue_dt} | expire date: {expiry_dt} | days to expire: {days_to_expire} |')
      else:
        send_success.append(f'| host: {url} | issue date: {issue_dt} | expire date: {expiry_dt} | days to expire: {days_to_expire} |')
    elif days_to_expire < 29:
      send_error.append(f'| host: {url} | issue date: {issue_dt} | expire date: {expiry_dt} | days to expire: {days_to_expire} |')
  except Exception as e:
    send_error.append(f'Ошибка при запросе на {url}, возможно что-то не так\n')
        
send_email = {
    "send_success": send_success,
    "send_error": send_error
}
print(send_email)
